review.notes: Machine-scanned all 35 physical pages with code-fence balance check (balanced) and normalized 4-gram containment of each page's extracted text against the OCR markdown. Low-containment pages 6, 9 and 24 were inspected: the misses are benchmark-table cell ordering (Table 1 values all present and match), figure-internal axis/legend/subfigure text (Figures 6-10 montage plots, Figure 24 prompt-grid labels) and hyphenated line-break splits ('demon-strates'), not droppage. Line-level checks on the footnote system, Equation 1, Table 1 and section headings. Full word-by-word proofreading of body prose was not performed, so coverage is partial.
